response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical leadership and backend systems experience, including event-driven architectures and distributed systems (Dunnhumby, GISCollective), but lacks explicit production experience with multi-agent AI systems, fintech infrastructure (credit risk, working capital), and regulated commercial environments. His recent role at re:cinq includes AI-agent infrastructure, which is promising but not yet proven in a fintech context. Leadership experience is solid but not at the scale (10-30+ engineers) or fintech-specific challenges described.
strengths: Proven backend and distributed-systems expertise with event-driven and microservices architectures (Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Experience scaling engineering teams and implementing CI/CD, TDD, and DevOps practices across multiple roles
Strong technical breadth with hands-on contributions across frontend, backend, embedded, and data systems
concerns: No explicit experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or fintech-specific applications (credit risk, working capital, trade decisioning)
Limited direct experience in regulated commercial environments with financial consequences
Recent AI-agent work (re:cinq) is promising but lacks depth in agentic frameworks, observability, and evaluation infrastructure required for this role

key_factors.factor: scaling engineering teams to 10-30+ people in fintech context
